scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/handlers/*.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external '@aws-sdk/*'
scripts.dev: AWS_REGION=us-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 bun src/dev/server.ts
scripts.dev:table: AWS_REGION=us-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 bun src/dev/localTable.ts
scripts.test:local: AWS_REGION=us-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 bun test
